title: $42 Billion Left This Bank in One Day #shorts
description:
In March twenty twenty-three, customers pulled forty-two billion dollars out of Silicon Valley Bank in a single day. By the next morning it was gone.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Would you have pulled your money out too, or stayed calm and waited? 👇

lines.text: Forty-two billion dollars left this bank in a single day.
What made everyone run at once?
Silicon Valley Bank held the money of thousands of tech startups.
It had parked billions in safe, long-term government bonds.
Then interest rates shot up, and those bonds lost value.
The bank sold some at a loss of nearly two billion dollars, and asked for more cash.
Founders panicked in group chats. Everyone hit withdraw from their phones.
The next morning, regulators shut it down.
Forty-two billion dollars, gone with a few taps on a phone.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
